slide_d: A soccer player running fast does a sliding tackle: drops onto one hip and slides along the grass with the legs stretched out in front, then gets back up.
slide_e: A baseball player sprints and does a feet-first slide into a base, the body low and leaning back with both legs stretched forward, then stands up.
slide_f: A person sprinting leans far back and slides along the floor on the back of the thighs, the legs in front, the hands off the ground, then pushes up to stand.
slide_g: A person runs, throws themselves down and slides forward on the floor lying on their back, feet first, then jumps up to their feet.
slide_h: A skater runs and drops into a very low crouch, sitting on the heels, and glides forward along the ground, then rises back up.
slide_i: A person runs to a low barrier, sits down and slides on the floor under it feet first, then gets up and carries on running.
